title: Rendered region of one drawing
description: Output of `harness render <work_dir> <file> (--sheet ID | --bbox X0 Y0 X1 Y1) [--tiles COLSxROWS] [--layer L ...] [--max-px N] [--no-overlay] [--out-dir DIR] [--input-dir DIR]` (stdout): one PNG per tile of a region of the drawing's MODEL SPACE (paper-space layouts are out of scope in version 0.1), drawn on a dark background with ezdxf and resvg-py, and the transform that maps an image pixel to drawing units. The command writes only the PNG files (default folder <work_dir>/renders, name <sheet or 'bbox'>-<10 hex of a sha1 of file, the file's sha256 in the inventory, region, tile, layers, max-px, overlay>.png, so a rerun overwrites the same file and a re-intake of a changed drawing does not). Transform: x = x0 + (px - left_margin_px) * units_per_px and y = y1 - (py - top_margin_px) * units_per_px; the drawn area is the requested region grown by less than half a pixel on each side, so the transform error is at most 0.12 px (the positions of solid geometry are exact; the dash pattern of an XLINE or RAY starts at the edge of the clip box, so its dashes may shift between tiles or after a change of region). Not drawn, as AutoCAD hides them: entities on an off or frozen layer, the content of an INSERT on a frozen layer (an off INSERT layer hides only its layer-0 content), entities and INSERTs with the invisible flag (counted in entities_invisible). Units are never converted (see `units`). Text is never read from an image: legacy-font text renders garbled, read it with sheet-text.

file.description: Inventory path of the drawing, relative to the input folder.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id whose bbox was drawn; null with --bbox.

bbox.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 of the --bbox region in model-space drawing units; null with --sheet (the sheet's bbox is in each image's region).

layers.description: Effective layers drawn, as given (compared case-insensitively; layer 0 in a block follows the placing INSERT, nested); empty = every layer. An INSERT is entered whatever its layer; a DIMENSION or another composite (LEADER, MLINE, ...) is kept or dropped as a whole by its own layer.

max_px.description: Longest edge allowed (at most 1568, the size above which the model downscales an image); the area is also held to 1,150,000 px.

overlay.description: Margin with ticks and labels in drawing units.

declared.description: The unit the header declares ($INSUNITS, as the probe reports it); null when none.

answered.description: The unit of the file's active units_confirm_all answer; null when not answered.

converted.description: Always false: every coordinate is in the drawing's units as stored.

images.description: One per tile, row by row from the top row, left to right.

region.description: x0, y0, x1, y1 of the requested tile in drawing units.

units_per_px.description: Drawing units per pixel, both axes (same as transform.units_per_px).

transform.description: x = x0 + (px - left_margin_px) * units_per_px; y = y1 - (py - top_margin_px) * units_per_px. Pixel (0, 0) is the top-left corner of the image.

left_margin_px.description: 94, or wider when a y label needs it (up to a quarter of --max-px).

x0.description: Drawing x at the left edge of the drawn area.

y1.description: Drawing y at the top edge of the drawn area.

entities_drawn.description: Entities ezdxf drew: each leaf once (an INSERT is entered, not counted, a nested one counts per placement), a composite (dimension, leader, ...) once; not the ones skipped (an XLINE or RAY that misses the region is not counted), hidden or invisible.

entities_pruned.description: Entities skipped because their box misses the region (an INSERT counts once).

entities_invisible.description: Entities in the region with the invisible flag (DXF group 60 = 1), on project 01 mostly the hidden visibility states of dynamic blocks, that ezdxf does not draw (an INSERT counts once, not its content; an entity hidden by its layer is not counted). `harness geometry` counts the content of such an INSERT instead.
